Macklin Celebrini.summary: Celebrini scored two goals, one on an overtime power play, and added a power-play assist in Tuesday's 4-3 win over the Canadiens.
Celebrini scored a goal on seven shots and added two power-play assists in Saturday's 4-3 shootout loss to the Red Wings.

Evan Bouchard.summary: Bouchard delivered two assists, including one on the power play, in a 7-2 loss to Toronto on Saturday.
Bouchard scored a power-play goal on three shots and added a power-play assist in Tuesday's 4-3 overtime win over the Wild.

Moritz Seider.summary: Seider notched two assists, two shots on goal, four hits and four blocked shots in Saturday's 4-3 shootout win over the Sharks.
Seider recorded a power-play assist, placed three shots on net, had four blocked shots and dished out a hit in Sunday's 3-2 loss to Winnipeg.

Jack Hughes.summary: Hughes produced a goal and an assist in Thursday's 4-1 win over the Ducks.
Hughes scored the game-winning goal and added two assists, one on the power play, in Tuesday's 5-4 overtime victory over the Red Wings.

Cutter Gauthier.summary: Gauthier notched an assist and four shots on goal in Friday's 4-2 loss to the Bruins.
Gauthier (upper body) will be in the lineup to face Boston on Friday, Derek Lee of The Hockey News reports.
Cutter Gauthier.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Derek Lee (The Hockey News)

Dylan Guenther.summary: Guenther scored a power-play goal on three shots in Saturday's 5-4 overtime win over the Lightning.
Guenther scored a goal on two shots, added an assist, logged six PIM and went plus-2 in Tuesday's 5-4 win over the Maple Leafs.

Jakob Chychrun.summary: Chychrun notched two assists, four shots on goal and five blocked shots in Saturday's 4-3 overtime win over the Sabres.
Chychrun scored a power-play goal, recorded an assist, placed three shots on net and served two PIM in Friday's 5-2 win over the Hurricanes.

Alex Tuch.summary: Tuch scored two goals on three shots, added two PIM and logged two hits in Saturday's 4-3 overtime win over the Sabres.
Tuch scored twice on three shots, added an assist and went plus-2 in Wednesday's 5-4 win over the Canadiens.

Jeremy Swayman.summary: Swayman stopped 23 of 27 shots in Saturday's 6-4 win over the Sharks.
Swayman will protect the home net against San Jose on Saturday, Jack Studley of Boston Hockey Now reports.
Jeremy Swayman.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Jack Studley (Boston Hockey Now)

Brandt Clarke.summary: Clarke scored the game-winning goal and added an assist in Thursday's 3-2 overtime victory over the Islanders.
Clarke scored a goal on six shots and added two PIM in Tuesday's 4-1 loss to the Oilers.

Tom Wilson.summary: Wilson scored an empty-net goal on three shots in Friday's 3-1 win over the Rangers. He also added three hits.
Wilson scored a goal on two shots, added two assists, logged two hits, blocked two shots and went plus-3 in Wednesday's 5-3 win over the Penguins.

Connor Bedard.summary: Bedard scored a goal, added two PIM and went minus-2 in Friday's 4-1 loss to the Canadiens.
Bedard scored a power-play goal on three shots and added an assist in Thursday's 4-3 overtime win over the Jets.

Connor Hellebuyck.summary: Hellebuyck was traded to the Devils from the Jets on Friday in exchange for Dawson Mercer, Nico Daws, Alexander Command, Nick Bjugstad (pectoral) and a pair of draft picks.
Hellebuyck (suspension) is not listed on the Jets' official roster, per the NHL media site Friday.

Pavel Dorofeyev.summary: Dorofeyev scored a goal on four shots, added two PIM and went minus-3 in Saturday's 7-4 loss to the Senators.
Dorofeyev scored a power-play goal Thursday in a 7-1 loss to New Jersey.

Mark Stone.summary: Stone scored a shorthanded goal on two shots in Tuesday's 6-2 loss to the Lightning.
Stone scored a power-play goal, added two assists and went plus-2 in Saturday's 6-2 win over the Penguins.

Justin Faulk.summary: Faulk scored a power-play goal on four shots, added two blocked shots and logged two PIM in Saturday's 4-3 shootout win over the Sharks.
Faulk scored the game-winning goal and added an assist in Tuesday's 5-3 win over Ottawa.

Gavin McKenna.summary: McKenna scored a power-play goal on one shot in Monday's 3-1 win over the Sharks.
McKenna played 17:56 in Saturday's 4-1 loss to the Islanders. He registered four shots and finished minus-2.

Shea Theodore.summary: Theodore scored a goal and went plus-3 in Saturday's 6-2 win over the Penguins.
Theodore scored a goal on four shots and blocked two shots in Friday's 4-3 loss to the Ducks.

Joel Eriksson Ek.summary: Eriksson scored a goal on two shots, added an assist and went plus-2 in Saturday's 5-1 win over the Kraken.
Eriksson Ek scored a goal on eight shots in Tuesday's 4-3 overtime loss to the Oilers.

Mikael Granlund.summary: Granlund didn't record a point while putting two shots on net with a minus-2 rating in Monday's 5-2 loss to the Rangers.
Granlund (upper body) is expected to play against the Rangers on Monday, per Zach Cavanagh of The Sporting Tribune.
Mikael Granlund.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Zach Cavanagh (The Sporting Tribune.)

Mackenzie Blackwood.summary: Blackwood stopped 31 of 34 shots in Friday's 6-3 win over the Lightning.
Blackwood will start Friday's home game against the Lightning, Evan Rawal of the Denver Gazette reports.
Mackenzie Blackwood.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Evan Rawal (Denver Gazette)

Carter Hart.summary: Hart stopped 18 of 20 shots on net in Saturday's 2-1 overtime loss to the Blue Jackets.
Hart will protect the road goal versus the Blue Jackets on Saturday, Mark Scheig of The Hockey Writers reports.
Carter Hart.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Mark Scheig (The Hockey Writers)

Simon Edvinsson.summary: Edvinsson (contract dispute) is on the Red Wings' injured, non-roster list, per the NHL media site Wednesday.
Edvinsson, who is a restricted free agent, has returned to Sweden to resume his training, per Andreas III Johnsson of Goteborgs-Posten on Wednesday.
Simon Edvinsson.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Andreas III Johnsson (Goteborgs-Posten)

Alex Laferriere.summary: Laferriere distributed two assists, posted a plus-2 rating, placed three shots on net, recorded two blocked shots, served two PIM and dished out four hits in Tuesday's 5-2 win over Washington.
Laferriere scored a goal on two shots, blocked two shots and went minus-2 in Saturday's 4-1 loss to the Bruins.

Darcy Kuemper.summary: Kuemper stopped 41 shots in Thursday's 3-2 overtime win over the Islanders.
Kuemper was the first goalie off during Thursday's morning skate, Stephen Whyno of the Associated Press reports, indicating that he'll draw the road start against the Islanders.
Darcy Kuemper.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Stephen Whyno (Associated Press)
